def.windowText: Assignments created between the two dates, inclusive. Every figure covers every assignment you are allowed to see, not one page.
def.assignedText: All assignments in the window currently held by the person (any status). Reassigned work counts for whoever holds it now.
def.activeMinutesText: Time spent in progress, from the transition history. Blocked time and time waiting for review are excluded.
def.timedText: Verified assignments with a transition history. Verified work closed without a history has no trustworthy times and is shown as untimed, never guessed.
def.reworkText: Returns from review divided by (verified + returns). N/A when nothing was verified or returned.
def.estimateText: Sum of active minutes against sum of estimates, only for verified work that has both. The sample size is shown beside it.
def.blockedText: From each block to the event that ended it (resume, complete or cancel). Blocks still open are counted up to now, separately.
def.queueText: Work submitted and waiting for review right now, for the chosen site, regardless of the window.
